text: ABOUT US IS LAID OUT AS THE DEPARTMENT PUBLISHES IT. The section is titled "About Us", as the live page and the design both have it, and it carries the whole mandate paragraph — the clause about working without updated demographic data had been cut to the About page, and it is the one thing in the paragraph a reader could not guess. Under it, the line the Ministry prints about itself, quoted as a pull-quote on the saffron wash the design draws; it had been left off as a restatement of the mandate, which it partly is, but it is the Ministry speaking about itself rather than about the Department. The four link rows are the three the Department offers here, in its own words — Our Team, Our Ministry, Our Reports — as bordered cells in a row rather than a ruled list; Citizen's Charter is in the footer. Beside them the Union Minister now leads in a card of his own across the row, portrait beside his name, with the two Ministers of State sharing the row below: a hierarchy three equal cards did not carry. THE DIVISIONS STAY, and the design does not draw them: Figma keeps the Important Links wall rail, which this build does not have (MOB-04 — it covered content on a phone), and nine division pages are reachable from nowhere else in the chrome. They moved under both columns as a quiet list, and they go the day the masthead carries them. Two token gaps recorded on the way: the estate publishes no `border/brand/secondary/*` rung at all, so the pull-quote's 4px saffron bar and the minister cards' edges bind to the secondary SURFACE rung whose value the design draws — a painted edge is a filled shape, not a hairline — and the ramp wants a secondary border family.
